career_ladder.note: Governed by the West Bengal Nursing Service Rules and administrative orders of the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal. Staff Nurses Grade II enter into the state health cadre at Pay Level 9 and advance through promotional grades and administrative appointments across primary health centres, sub-divisional hospitals, district hospitals, and state medical college hospitals.

exam_scheme.note: Direct recruitment is conducted by the West Bengal Health Recruitment Board (WBHRB) following a 100-mark standardized selection framework comprising Academic Qualifications (75 marks), Professional Experience (10 marks), and Interview with Language Assessment (15 marks). Candidates must possess registration as Female/Male Nurse-Midwife with the West Bengal Nursing Council. The Board reserves statutory authority under Clause H of the advertisement to conduct a preliminary screening Written Examination / Computer Based Test (CBT) if the volume of applicants necessitates screening prior to interview.

financial_package.note: Pay scale for Staff Nurse Grade II is fixed under WBS (ROPA) Rules, 2019, Pay Level 9 with starting entry basic pay of ₹29,800. Minimum initial emoluments were officially notified at ₹39,500 in the recruitment notification (comprising basic pay ₹29,800, DA ₹5,364, HRA ₹3,576, Medical Allowance ₹500, and Uniform/Washing Allowance ₹260). Accounting for the repository standard 58% Dearness Allowance (effective 1 Jul 2025), monthly gross remuneration is estimated at approximately ₹51,400.
financial_package.pay_source_label: WBHRB Advertisement No. R/Staff Nurses, Gr. II/GNM/7/2025 & No. R/Staff Nurses, Gr. II/Basic & Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing/8/2025 (Section B: Scale of Pay)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on ROPA 2019 Level 9 entry basic pay of ₹29,800 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (₹17,284), House Rent Allowance (12% of basic pay under ROPA 2019, ₹3,576), Medical Allowance (MA ₹500), and Uniform/Washing Allowance (₹260). Deductions include 10% NPS employee contribution (₹4,708) and West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹150–₹200).
official_perks: 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA) or government staff nursing quarters in hospital premises
Monthly Medical Allowance (MA ₹500) or coverage under West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS)
Uniform and Washing Allowance sanctioned per health service rules
Night shift duty allowance and emergency healthcare shift compensations
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) and General Provident Fund as per state service rules

competition_benchmarks.note: Official vacancies advertised by the West Bengal Health Recruitment Board under the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal. In the 2025 recruitment drive, 5,018 total vacancies were advertised (2,436 GNM under Advt. No. R/Staff Nurses, Gr. II/GNM/7/2025 and 2,582 B.Sc. Nursing under Advt. No. R/Staff Nurses, Gr. II/Basic & Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing/8/2025). In the 2021 cycle (Advt. No. R/Staff Nurse, Gr-II/02/2021), 6,114 vacancies were advertised (3,974 GNM, 2,032 Basic B.Sc. Nursing, 108 Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing).
